title: Common/CardsTable
desc: A grid of entity cards built from a per-view template. The card content is produced by the cardRender function property (row) => TemplateResult, the same pattern as the cellRender of app-data-table; the card shell (surface background, border, radius, padding, hover lift, selection highlight) and the grid geometry belong to the component and are retuned locally through the geometry tokens. Pagination is internal: items are sliced by page-size and app-pagination (layout-mode="cards") sits in the footer below the grid whenever the grid is not empty. With clickable the shell activates on click and emits card-click; with selectable the selection lives in selectedKeys keyed by key-field, the chosen cards get the is-selected shell class, and toggling emits selection-change. Additive hooks with pixel-identical defaults: --cards-columns pins the column count (default auto-fill), the wide-collapse attribute collapses to one column at viewport <= 1024px (default off), cardClass(row) appends extra shell classes per row (is-dimmed reads --card-dimmed-opacity, default 0.68).

title: Inputs/Switch
desc: Toggle switch for boolean settings and feature flags. The default slot overrides the label property with custom label markup. Three additive hook groups extend it: size takes the canonical control scale sm|md|lg, frame draws a control box around the switch (the app-input geometry) so the switch can be placed in a modal exactly like a regular input, and field-label / field-label-style attach an external label row to that frame. All hooks default to the historical bare switch (size md, frame none, field-label-style none), so every existing consumer stays pixel-identical, and the caption inside the control behaves as before in every variant. The geometry lives in tokens — --switch-track-width (40px), --switch-track-height (22px), --switch-thumb-size (18px), --switch-thumb-offset (2px), --switch-thumb-travel (18px), --switch-caption-font-size (0.8125rem), --switch-gap (0.65rem) — and the frame box through --switch-frame-height (var(--control-height-md, 38px)), --switch-frame-bg (var(--bg-surface, #111827)), --switch-frame-border (1px solid var(--border-subtle, #334155)), --switch-frame-radius (var(--radius-md, 8px)) and --switch-frame-padding (0 0.75rem); the gap between the external label row and the control is --switch-label-gap (0.35rem, the app-input form-group gap). For frame=transparent the background and border are forced transparent regardless of the tokens.

title: Views/Contacts
desc: Unified contact persons directory across all counterparties with cards and table views, role/type filtering, quick copy, and full CRUD.

title: Views/Contract Detail
desc: Отдельная страница договора: финансовое исполнение, реквизиты сторон, процедура выставления счетов с автоподбором часов и расходов проекта.

title: Views/Contracts
desc: Contracts registry linking internal companies, counterparties, projects, owners, and budgets.

title: Views/Dashboard

title: Views/Expenses
